about.desc:
Fontora — font management made simple.
Preview fonts, organize your library, add tags and favorites, and install, enable or disable fonts in one clean desktop app.
From finding and comparing to everyday upkeep, every font in its place — so you can focus on creating.

detail.visibleElsewhere: Visible in other apps' font pickers
detail.systemFont: System font — managed by the OS
detail.conflictBody: Multiple installed files claim the same identity. Apps may pick either one unpredictably.
detail.conflictSystemProtected: System font — protected, can't be removed or trashed

settings.title: Settings
settings.closeToTraySub: Closing the window keeps Fontora running in the tray.
settings.autostartSub: Launch Fontora when you sign in.
settings.startMinimizedSub: Start in the tray without opening the window.
settings.watchSub: Rescan automatically when fonts appear in scanned folders
settings.autoActivateSub: Newly imported fonts start active right away (small batches under 64 only)
settings.watchedFoldersSub: Scanned in addition to your system font directories
settings.affinityDeactivateSub: Turn session fonts off when Affinity closes
settings.affinityHelp: Needs Affinity 3.2+ with Settings > Model Context Protocol enabled (restart after).
settings.onlineEnableSub: Search a catalogue of open-licence fonts and add them to your library
settings.onlineHosts: Contacts api.fontsource.org and raw.githubusercontent.com — only when you search or download
settings.onlineHelp: Nothing is sent until you open the Online section. Your own library is never uploaded. Fonts come from the google/fonts repository with their licence text.
settings.curationSub: Back up your curation to a file, or merge one in from another machine
settings.translateSub: Add it yourself with a small pull request — or just ask, and I will add it.
settings.themeSub: Same glass, different light — System follows your desktop
settings.skinSub: The color mood of the interface; Default is the original violet glass
settings.reduceMotionSub: Replace springs with quick fades, regardless of system setting
settings.reduceTransparencySub: Solid panels instead of frosted glass — clearer to read, and much lighter on older graphics
settings.interfaceSoundsSub: Soft synthesized feedback for toggles and notifications

palette.placeholder: Jump to a font or run a command…
bulk.title: Tag {count} fonts
tour.inviteSub: A one-minute tour of your new font library.
tour.welcome.title: Welcome to Fontora
tour.welcome.body: Every font on this machine, in one place — preview, organize, activate, and install. This tour takes about a minute.
tour.sample.title: Your words, every font
tour.sample.body: Type anything here and the whole library re-renders in it. Try your brand name or that headline you're setting.
tour.size.title: Preview size
tour.size.body: Drag from caption-small to poster-huge. The scale is stepped so useful sizes are easy to hit.
tour.search.title: Find anything
tour.search.body: Search by name, tag, format, foundry — even your own notes. Press / from anywhere to jump here.
tour.views.title: Three ways to look
tour.views.body: Grid for browsing, list for managing, waterfall to study one typeface across every size.
tour.card.title: A font family
tour.card.body: The pill switch activates or deactivates it system-wide — deactivated fonts vanish from other apps' pickers but stay in your library. Star favorites, right-click for everything else.
tour.inspector.title: The inspector
tour.inspector.body: Click any font to open this panel: switch styles, drag variable axes, browse every glyph, export files, read the license. Drag its edge to resize.
tour.collections.title: Collections
tour.collections.body: Group fonts per project or client — “Client X”, “Personal brand”. Create one here, then right-click any font to add it.
tour.trash.title: Nothing is ever lost
tour.trash.body: Uninstalled fonts land in the trash, not the void. Restore them any time.
tour.settings.title: Settings
tour.settings.body: Pick your language, watch folders for new fonts, add extra scan locations, tune motion and sounds.
tour.last.title: One last thing
tour.last.body: Drag font files, folders, or zip archives anywhere onto this window to install them. That's it — enjoy your library.

online.noMatchBody: Try a shorter search or fewer filters.

online.narrowDown_other: {count} more — narrow the search to see them
fontDetail.installableDetail: fsType is 0: the font may be embedded, distributed and edited without restriction.
fontDetail.licenseNote: These permissions are read from the font's own OS/2 fsType field and its embedded license text. They describe what the file permits technically; they are not a substitute for the license the foundry publishes, and not legal advice.
fontDetail.coverageNote: Each row compares the font's cmap against a published character list: covered / defined. Five stars means the list is essentially complete.
dupe.noteIdentical: These files share the same SHA-256, so removing the extras loses no glyph. System fonts are always off-limits — the app will not touch them.
dupe.noteSameName: Same family and weight, different file contents (another version or another foundry's build). Check which one you actually want before removing.
dupe.emptyBody: Every font has a distinct content hash, and no family appears twice with different builds. Run this again after installing new fonts.
dupe.footnote: Removing moves the file to the app's trash (restorable from Trash), unregisters the font and tells other apps to refresh.
dupe.toastRemovedSub: You can restore them from Trash any time.
menu.exportCollectionTitle: Choose a folder for the unpacked fonts
toast.notCollectionDetail: The file holds a single face — use "Export this face" instead.
export.title: Export font
export.fileNote: Save one face out of the file. Collections (TTC/OTC) are genuinely split into standalone files.
export.renameNote: Only the internal names are rewritten (family, full name, PostScript name); copyright and licence text are kept verbatim. A non-ASCII family name keeps the original PostScript name.
export.subsetNote: Drop unused characters, then compress — often a tenth of the size. TrueType outlines only.
export.textPlaceholder: Paste the text you need — only those characters are kept
export.textRequired: Enter the characters to keep first
export.titleCollection: Choose a folder for the unpacked fonts
ref.title: References
ref.subtitle: Scan design files and source code to see which fonts they use and which are missing.
ref.pickTitle: Choose a design or project folder
ref.emptySub: Supports AI / PDF / EPS, SVG / HTML / CSS / JS / Vue, Sketch / Office documents, and binary design files such as PSD.
cmap.title: Character map
cmap.searchPlaceholder: Type a character to check coverage
cmap.failed: Could not read the character map
cmap.empty: This font maps no Unicode characters.
cmap.outside: {count} more characters fall outside the blocks above.
cmap.pickHint: Pick a character to inspect it
health.title: Font health
health.verdictGood: Structure and coverage look fine — safe to use.
health.verdictOk: Usable, with a few things worth knowing.
health.verdictBad: Fundamental problems — it may not work even if installed.
export2.title: Export
export2.catalogNote: One row per style: family, style, weight, character counts, hash, tags and notes. The CSV carries a BOM so Excel opens Chinese text without mojibake.
export2.packageNote: Bundles the font files, fonts.css, manifest.json and a license sheet into one zip you can unzip straight into a project.
export2.webHint: WOFF2 is reliable for TrueType outlines only; a full CJK font takes seconds to build. Up to 200 styles at a time.
export2.cssNote: Paths assume the package layout (fonts/… or web/…). If you paste this elsewhere, point them at the real font location.
usage.title: Usage
usage.subtitle: Every opened detail page, install and project reference is counted here. No record does not mean unused — it means it has not been opened on this machine since it arrived.
usage.recentHint: Sorted by last sighting. Click a row to open its detail page.
usage.neverHint: Largest first. This is not proof they are useless — system fonts sit here because you never opened them.
usage.cleanHint: No sighting in 90 days, not a favourite, in no collection, over 1 MB each.
usage.cleanNone: Nothing qualifies right now — everything is either new or filed away.
usage.cleanHintSub: This only builds a collection; no file is touched. Look through it before deleting anything.
usage.emptySub: Opening a font's detail page adds a view; installs and reference scans count separately.
usage.views: Times the detail page was opened
usage.refs: Times referenced by a design file or source
org.title: Auto-organise
org.subtitle: Sort font files into subfolders by a rule. You see the plan first; nothing moves until you confirm.
org.source.libraryHint: All files in the library — {count} of them.
org.source.folderHint: Only the font files in this folder; it does not need to be in the library.
org.sourceEmpty: Pick a folder first and the files to organize will appear here.
org.sourceNoFonts: No font files in this folder.
org.scanFailed: This folder could not be read
org.key.vendorHint: Uses the vendor name inside the font. Fonts without one land in Unknown.
org.key.languageHint: CJK first, then Korean, Arabic… Latin always ranks last (far too many fonts cover it).
org.key.formatHint: TTF / OTF / WOFF / WOFF2 apart; a TTC goes by the format of the file itself.
org.mode.copyHint: Originals stay put, the archive gets a second copy. Costs space, fully reversible.
org.mode.moveHint: Files leave their old location. Files currently activated are skipped.
org.mode.linkHint: No double space — both paths point at the same data. Same volume only.
org.nothingToDo: Nothing to handle — they may all already be in place.
org.moveWarn: Moving takes {count} files out of their current location; undoing it means moving them back by hand.
org.outsideLibrary: The destination is outside the library folders. Moved files disappear from the library — they still exist, they just stop being scanned.
org.toastCopied: Originals untouched, a copy sits in the archive
rating.label: Rating
alias.title: Aliases
alias.open: Add an alias — aliases are searchable, including by pinyin
alias.placeholder: A name you will remember, press Enter to add
alias.hint: Aliases join the search: after adding one, “思源”, “siyuan” and “syht” all find it. Up to 8.
backup.title: Backup & migration
backup.subtitle: Pack tags, collections, favourites, ratings, aliases and settings into one file — and check what touched your files lately.
backup.exportHint: One zip. Import it on the next machine and everything above comes back.
backup.withFilesSub: Much bigger, but the new machine won't have to find them again.
backup.withUsageSub: View, install and reference counts survive the move.
backup.importHint: Look inside first, then decide how to merge.
backup.unknownTitle: {count} families aren't in this library yet.
backup.unknownHint: Their names are kept — import the fonts later and the data reconnects.
backup.staleHint: {count} recorded paths don't exist here and will be skipped.
backup.mode.mergeHint: Fill the gaps only: local tags, ratings and notes stay; collections are unioned.
backup.mode.replaceHint: Same-name entries are overwritten, and settings are restored too.
backup.doneSummary: {tags} tags · {collections} collections · {favorites} favourites · {ratings} ratings · {aliases} aliases · {notes} notes
backup.doneFonts: {written} font files written, {skipped} already in the library
backup.doneSettings: Settings were restored too; some appearance options apply after a restart.
backup.doneDirs: {count} watched folders no longer exist and were dropped
audit.title: Activity log
audit.subtitle: Installs, removals, activation and archiving — anything that touched files.
audit.emptySub: Install, remove, activate or archive something and it will show up here.
audit.kind.self-heal: Rolled back {count} activations left by an unclean exit
empty.installed.title: Everything in the library is installed
empty.installed.body: Fonts Windows can currently use appear here. Switching one off takes it out of the system without touching the file.
empty.notInstalled.title: Nothing waiting to be installed
empty.notInstalled.body: Fonts the library knows about but Windows cannot use yet show up here. Add a folder under Font folders to bring in fonts you have not installed.
folders.title: Font folders
folders.subtitle: Point the library at any folder on this machine. Whatever fonts live there — installed or not — get indexed, previewed and watched for changes.
folders.duplicate: That folder is already in the list.
folders.emptyBody: Only the two Windows font folders are being scanned right now. Add a folder such as E:\字体 to manage fonts you have not installed.
folders.hintScan: A new folder is scanned straight away. With watching on, added, changed and deleted files update the library on their own.
folders.hintRemove: Removing a folder only stops managing it. No font file is ever moved or deleted.
